pillars.title:
The essentials of their health,
without losing track.
pillars.subtitle: A space that connects their history, their family, and the professionals who accompany them.
pillars.item1Desc: Visits, diagnoses, treatments, vaccines, and results gathered in each pet's history, beyond a single clinic.
pillars.item1Sub: Their history doesn't change when changing centers.
pillars.item2Desc: Grant or revoke access to a specific vet or center. Decide if they can view the history or also update it.
pillars.item3Desc: Find centers by specialty, proximity, and ratings in a curated directory.

how.title:
A first step.
Lots of care
ahead.
how.subtitle: Start with their name. The rest of their story is built together.
how.vetDesc: Log in with your professional profile to view and update authorized histories.
how.step1Desc: Register your pets. Each one will have its own file and a history that will accompany it throughout its life.
how.step2Desc: Authorize the vet or center of your choice and assign access level. You can change or revoke it whenever you need.
how.step3Title: Follow their story, visit by visit
how.step3Desc: Check the entries added by authorized professionals, with the author's identity always visible.

about.quote: Continuity of care begins with sharing what matters.
about.title: Technology at the service of a very real bond.
about.p1: [Título del proyecto] was born as an academic project with a simple idea: that health information accompanies each pet, instead of being scattered among papers and centers.
about.p2: We design a meeting point between families and professionals. A place to better understand their history, share it wisely, and give continuity to their care.
about.banner: More context to care. More clarity to accompany.

faq.title:
Things clear,
from the beginning.
faq.subtitle: Some answers to better understand this space and how information is shared.
faq.disclaimer: [Título del proyecto] organizes information. It does not replace the evaluation or care of a veterinary professional.
faq.q1: Who can see my pet's history?
faq.a1: You and the vets or centers you have given permission to. As an owner, you decide who can only view it and who can add or update information. You can revoke that access whenever you need.
faq.q2: Can I register more than one pet?
faq.q3: Who adds clinical information to the history?
faq.q4: Does it connect to my clinic's system?
faq.q5: What information will I find about the centers?
